question: Where is the Narora Nuclear Power plant located ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narora Nuclear Power Plant** is located in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is situated in the Bulandshahar district, near the town of Narora.
 
• The plant is operated by the **Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd (NPCIL)**.
 
• It consists of two units, each with a capacity of 220 MW, and is part of India's efforts to expand its nuclear energy capacity.
 
• The plant uses pressurized heavy water reactors (PHWR) for its operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Narora Nuclear Power Plant** is one of the significant nuclear power stations in northern India.
 
• It contributes to the national grid and plays a crucial role in meeting the energy demands of the region.
 
• Safety measures and regular maintenance are key focuses to ensure the plant's safe and efficient operation.
 
• India's nuclear energy program aims to increase the share of nuclear power in the country's total energy mix to provide a stable and sustainable energy supply.
